card.name: The word of after one or some
card.fires_on: The word "of" right after "one" or "some" when a superlative phrase follows, such as "one of his most stately melodies". It is general web prose, not drug-label text.

card.writes: It seems to promote words that begin a superlative or emphatic description and to suppress words that suggest accident or failure.
card.plain: It fires on the "of" in phrases like "one of the most...", where a superlative is about to come.
